data.name: Farhaad
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Farhaad means 'one who brings good news'. This name is derived from the root words 'farh' (good news) and 'ad' (to send). In Islamic history, Farhaad is mentioned in the Quran as the name of the servant of Prophet Sulaiman (Solomon) who was sent to the Queen of Sheba with a letter. The name is also associated with the concept of delivering good news and spreading positivity.
